evidence:
Scope is the source configuration required by quality row 10, not empirical verifier launch. The actual frozen rules/WebDev Rubrics QC.xlsx was opened with openpyxl: Quality Checks row 11 requires separate verifier, pinned image/dependencies, the unchanged five-key environment block, no per-judge model, and public network without mandatory allowlist. Internal Quality Checks row 11 retains older wording mentioning an allowlist; the shipped Quality Checks wording and frozen skill Delivery profile explicitly supersede that interpretation. Deterministic Checks rows 2, 10, 11, and 29 were also read for relevant network, image, and judge-schema interpretation. Frozen references/quality-checks.md:47-48 specifies environment_mode = "separate", pinned Dockerfile bases/npm/pip, frozen env block, and no judge model.
All task paths below are relative to .qc-cache/coldwater-2026-09-30-postrepair-audit/task. task.toml:26-38 has environment_mode = "separate" at line 28; [verifier.env] at line 30 contains exactly REWARDKIT_JUDGE = "claude-code", REWARDKIT_MODEL = "z-ai/glm-5.3-flashx", ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL = "https://openrouter.ai/api", ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN = "${OPENROUTER_API_KEY}", and ANTHROPIC_API_KEY = "" at lines 31-35. A read-only Python assertion verified the raw block bytes equal the frozen template task.toml block and the parsed dictionary has exactly those five values. verifier.environment.network_mode is "public" at line 38, without an allowlist; this conforms to the current profile. The token is a variable reference, not a literal credential.
tests/Dockerfile:1-2 uses the frozen template's explicit version tags node:22-bookworm-slim and python:3.12-slim. Lines 17-21 pin all direct npm installs to @anthropic-ai/claude-code@2.1.281, @openai/codex@0.151.0, @playwright/mcp@0.0.79, express@5.1.0 and better-sqlite3@12.4.1. Line 31 pins harbor-rewardkit==0.1.7; lines 33-35 install the browser using that pinned MCP dependency's bundled Playwright CLI. Lines 43-45 copy /tests into the separate verifier image and restrict its permissions. The entire verifier Dockerfile is byte-equal to the frozen template. These are the template's version-tag pins; this does not claim digest-level immutability. Unversioned apt packages at lines 12-14 are explicitly NOTE-only under Deterministic Checks row 11. environment/Dockerfile is likewise byte-equal to the frozen template; its COPY lines 14-15 take only instructions and assets into the agent image.
Every judge.toml was parsed in full: tests/gates/constraints/judge.toml, tests/gates/render/judge.toml, tests/scored/functional/judge.toml, tests/scored/polish/judge.toml and tests/scored/visual/judge.toml. In each, line 2 is judge = "claude-code" and the entire parsed [judge] table has no model, reasoning_effort, temperature, or weight. Their isolated = false at line 5 is the canonical per-judge setting (staged-task-contract.md:116-127), distinct from verifier.environment_mode = separate. Each Playwright server uses --isolated at line 12. Functional additionally invokes /usr/local/bin/python3 at line 17 for the restart tool. tests/test.sh:63-65 requires the configured REWARDKIT_JUDGE and REWARDKIT_MODEL; its RewardKit call at lines 207-209 supplies no overriding model. App launch and restart use sanitized env -i at lines 104-111 and 160-167; API credentials are not forwarded in those environments. tests/test.sh also matches the frozen template bytes.
Read-only validation passed: the exact environment block, separate mode, public network, all five judge tables, and in-memory negative controls. All 50 frozen task file hashes matched manifest.json; existing frozen rule files were also checked against their manifest hashes. raw-evidence-index.json identifies its available observations as scripted browser evidence and expressly records no full configured verifier, Oracle, target-model run, or measured judge workload. No Docker, network, credential authentication, or judge launch was performed for this row; the source pass does not clear those separate runtime requirements.
counterexample: Conforming false-fail control: all five canonical judge tables have isolated = false while task.toml has environment_mode = "separate"; treating the former as evidence of a nonseparate verifier would wrongly reject this conforming configuration. Similarly, the canonical public-network setup legitimately has no allowlist. Broken false-pass control: injected model = "unintended-model" into an in-memory copy of each of the five parsed [judge] tables. The row-specific validation rejected all five despite the still-correct [verifier.env] block, demonstrating why reading only task.toml would miss a real override. These controls changed no task bytes; no actual false-pass defect was found.
